title: Topic 19: Health & Body - Listening
description: One audio (2 speakers) + 5 exercises including dictation.
canDoStatement: Say what hurts, name body parts, manage a pharmacy visit

listeningBlock.audioScript:
Zilda: Hello, Beto! Where are you? Everyone is at
the office!
Beto:  I am at home, Zilda. I am sick today. I have a
headache, and my body is tired, tired, tired...
Zilda: Oh no! So you can't work today?
Beto:  No, I can't. I can't go to work today. Sorry!
Zilda: Don't say sorry! Go to bed, drink water, and
sleep.
Beto:  Thank you. My sister is at the pharmacy now -
she is buying my medicine.

listeningQuestions.question: Why does Zilda call Beto?
options: Because he is not at the office
listeningQuestions.correctAnswer: Because he is not at the office

listeningQuestions.question: What is wrong with Beto?
options: He has a headache and a tired body
listeningQuestions.correctAnswer: He has a headache and a tired body

listeningQuestions.question: Why is Beto's sister at the pharmacy?
options: Because Beto is sick and needs medicine
Because it is next to her house
listeningQuestions.correctAnswer: Because Beto is sick and needs medicine

listeningQuestions.question: Type what you hear.
listeningQuestions.correctAnswer: I can't go to work today

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_topic19_health_body.txt, Lesson 19.2. Dictation is the only typed item.
